caption: The drawing depicts an ornate object featuring a large oval mirror in the center, surrounded by an intricate, interwoven circular frame with dark gold or bronze coloring. On either side of the mirror, there are two small statuettes of women dressed in cream-colored, tiered dresses with red and black details; the women stand facing slightly outward. Below the mirror and between the figures, stylized green palm fronds extend from a central stem, forming a canopy-like structure. Beneath these fronds, at the base, there is an obelisk-shaped monument in gray, accompanied to its left by a waving American flag with red and white stripes and a blue field with white stars. To the right of the obelisk, there is a bouquet of yellowish flowers. The composition is anchored at the bottom by a wide, ornate, dark gold scrolling base, with textured and symmetrical decorations. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, placing emphasis on the central objects.
title: Dressing Mirror (cast iron)
